title: Wall segments
description: Vector wall segments for one map, in grid cells. Endpoints are multiples of the file's snap: 1/8 cell (maps imported before 2026-11-14) or 1/32 cell (checked by tools/validate.mjs). See docs/design/maps.md sections 4 and 5.

snap.description: Endpoint precision in cells: 1/8, or 1/32 for maps imported at print resolution (2026-11-14).

w.description: Wall thickness in cells: a and b are its centre line. Sight, light, sound and movement meet its faces (half w each side, ends squared off w/2 past a and b), so it is solid through and walls meet at their centres; sight sees a wall to its far face, so the fog reveals the whole drawn wall. Not for doors, one-way walls or proximity walls. Missing: a line with no thickness.

dir.description: 0 both sides, 1 blocks only from the left of a->b, 2 only from the right.

dc.description: GM-only: DC to find (secret) or unlock.

stuck_dc.description: GM-only: the door is stuck; DC to Force it Open.

blocked.description: GM-only: what blocks the door (rubble, debris) and how to get past.

auto_find.description: Secret door that is found automatically as soon as someone can see it (left ajar, obvious from this side).

pair.description: Double door: the door id of the other leaf. Each leaf has its own state; the two leaves name each other.

hinge.description: Which end of the segment the leaf turns on.

swing.description: Which side of a->b the leaf opens toward (y down, as for dir).

prox.description: Distances in feet for proximity senses.
